title: Workload Stitcher and Differential Golden Suite for Kernel Advisor Validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a deterministic, stitchable workload generator (Workload Stitcher) plus a differential golden-suite to validate kernel-advisor decisions across prefill and decode scheduling permutations. The goal is to surface end-to-end regressions introduced by kernel routing/attention changes and to make CI perf gates both sensitive and minimally noisy.
background: Current golden baselines are brittle to small distributional shifts and we lack deterministic composition for mixed-session workloads. Kernel-advisor changes (routing heuristics, attention tiling) show sporadic flakiness in CI and long debugging cycles. We need a harness that can programmatically stitch micro-workloads into realistic sessions, run paired differential comparisons, and provide signal for automatic CI gating.
proposed_solution: Implement a Workload Stitcher that composes canonical micro-profiles (short chat, long-form generation, streaming responses, high-KV reuse) into reproducible session traces. Couple this with a differential runner that executes candidate vs baseline model/runtime permutations and aggregates token-level latency, p50/p95/p99, and correctness deltas. Add a stability weighting scheme to reduce noisy tests and extend CI to require pass on a stratified subset of golden suites before merging runtime changes.
milestones: M1: Define canonical micro-profiles and stitcher API (spec + YAML schema)
M2: Implement deterministic stitcher and trace replay engine (local harness)
M3: Differential runner with token-level delta aggregation and signal scoring
M4: CI integration and perf-gate thresholds for runtime PRs
M5: Dashboard and nightly golden refresh + regression alerting
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Stitcher can compose 5 predefined micro-profiles into a session and replay deterministically across machines
AC2: Differential runner produces reproducible latency and correctness deltas with <5% noise on p95 across 10 runs
AC3: CI perf gate fails PRs when differential score exceeds threshold on stratified golden subset
AC4: Dashboard shows historical runs, flagged regressions, and links to failing traces
AC5: Playbook documented for updating golden baselines and triaging false positives
progress_updates: 2025-10-28: Ticket created after spike showing CI flakiness for kernel-advisor changes; scoped initial set of micro-profiles.

2025-11-02: API spec for stitcher reviewed by Applied ML and Infra; agreed on YAML session schema and seed-based RNG for determinism. Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Workload+Stitcher
2025-11-06: Initial stitcher prototype committed; local replay reproduces composed session on two dev machines. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523

2025-11-09: Differential runner prototype emits token-level latency traces and correctness hashes. Preliminary runs show a noisy p99 on long-form generation; added stability-weighting experiment to downweight outlier micro-profiles.

2025-11-12: CI integration spike completed. Lightweight stratified subset added to nightly; need to tune thresholds before enabling pre-merge gating. Planning next 2-week sprint to harden noise reduction and build dashboard panels.
